findings.title: Page is missing a meta description
findings.detail: The meta description is the grey summary line under your result in Google. A good one lifts click-through; a missing one lets Google scrape a random sentence.
findings.recommendation: Write a 140 to 160 character description per page that reads like an ad and mentions the product.

For a product/collection/page: the "Search engine listing" section on that item, or the Admin API seo.description field. Write ~150 characters that read like an ad.
fix.estimated_impact: Quick win, low effort, improves SEO or trust.

findings.title: No structured data (schema) found
findings.detail: Product schema is what lets Google show price, rating stars and stock status directly in search results. Without it you lose that eye-catching real estate.
findings.recommendation: Add Product and Organization JSON-LD schema; most Shopify themes and a free app can do this.

fix.explanation: Product schema is what lets Google show price, rating stars and stock status directly in search results.
fix.generated_fix: Add Product JSON-LD in the product template using Liquid variables so each product fills its own values (name {{ product.title }}, price {{ product.price | money_without_currency }}, availability, image {{ product.featured_image | image_url }}). A free SEO app can also do this.

findings.detail: The largest content element painted in 3.67s. Google recommends an LCP under 2.5s for optimal user experience and SEO ranking.

findings.title: Images missing width and height attributes (CLS risk)
findings.detail: 4 images on this page lack explicit width and height attributes. Without dimensions, the browser cannot reserve vertical space before image bytes arrive, causing layout shifts (CLS) that push content down.
findings.recommendation: Add width and height attributes to all tags, or use Shopify's image_tag filter which automatically sets proper width and height.

findings.title: Render-blocking scripts in the head
findings.detail: Scripts placed in the head without async or defer stop the page from showing anything until they finish downloading and running. The shopper stares at a blank screen for longer than they need to.
findings.recommendation: Add defer (or async where safe) to these scripts, or move them just before the closing body tag.

fix.explanation: Scripts placed in the head without async or defer stop the page from showing anything until they finish downloading and running.
fix.generated_fix: Add the defer attribute to render-blocking theme scripts, e.g. <script src="..." defer></script>, or move them before the closing body tag. Test that nothing above the fold depends on them.

findings.title: No canonical tag
findings.detail: A canonical tag tells Google which URL is the 'real' one when the same product is reachable through several URLs. Missing it can split ranking signals.
findings.recommendation: Add a self-referencing canonical link to each page (Shopify themes usually include this by default).

fix.explanation: A canonical tag tells Google which URL is the 'real' one when the same product is reachable through several URLs.

findings.title: No Open Graph tags for social sharing
findings.detail: Open Graph tags control the image and text shown when the page is shared on WhatsApp, Instagram or Facebook. Without them, links look bare and get fewer clicks.
findings.recommendation: Add og:title, og:description and og:image so shared links show a proper preview.
